checks.name: rig_deferred
checks.note: skeleton, skin weights and clips are produced by the RIG stage

silhouette.reason: The preview reads as the designed 1930s captain: long grey-green storm coat with shoulder cape, peaked cap with gold badge, high collar, wide belt with knife and pouch gear, tall boots, and 1.8 m human proportions. Prototype-level simplification only; no required part is missing.

orientation.reason: The face, chest and coat opening face -Y. The preview camera in harness/pipeline/blender/bp_common.py is placed on the -Y side (center + (d*sin35, -d*cos35, 0.42d)) and sees the face; independently, the imported toe bones point -Y (LeftToes/RightToes head y=-0.0733, tail y=-0.1919). The model is upright with feet down and head at Z~1.80.

pivot.reason: FBX reimport reports pivot_at_origin (-0.00044, 0.00045, 0.00026) m and size_m 1.8006. Raw bounds are X -0.5329..0.5320, Y -0.2657..0.2666, Z 0.00026..1.8009, so the origin is at the feet centre rather than a mesh corner or bone joint.

joint_topology.reason: One armature with 21 bones using standard deform names: Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Left/Right Shoulder, UpperArm, LowerArm, Hand, UpperLeg, LowerLeg, Foot, Toes. Bone rest is T-pose (arms horizontal at Z~1.528, hands at X~+/-0.708) and all four clips are present: idle 1-61, walk 1-33, attack 1-25, death 1-49. Caveat: the skinned mesh is authored in an arms-down A-pose (raw width 1.065 m), so the T-pose arm bones lie outside the sleeve geometry; Unity Humanoid accepts A-pose, but this mismatch is the root of the deformation issue below.

deformation.reason: PASS with explicit caveat (prototype_only). Numeric gates pass: 11481/11481 vertices weighted, 21/21 bones weighted, deform_max_disp 0.684 under the 1.1254 threshold. The placeholder rig does NOT deform cleanly: the delivered attack clip at frame 8 tears, pulling a ~0.7 m triangular spike of coat/shoulder geometry up from the right shoulder while the right hand stays at the hip even though the RightUpperArm/LowerArm/Hand bones are at Z 1.65-1.85. Root cause: the armature rest is T-pose while the mesh is authored arms-down A-pose (raw width 1.065 m), so the arm bones sit outside the sleeve; envelope weights are broad (up to 11 influences/vertex; top-4 weights cover only 0.52-0.56 for the lowest 5% of vertices, so Unity's 4-bone limit drops weight), and no vertex is dominated by LeftHand/RightHand, so the hand bones do not drive the hand mesh. This is accepted only because the operator explicitly chose option A, the procedural placeholder rig, on 2026-11-22 (recorded in tasks/TASK-035.json) knowing automatic weights are rough; the deliverable is prototype_only with registry review pending, explicitly not shipping, and 'placeholders are not acceptance' means this pilot proves the pipeline chain, not final character art. A follow-up task will improve pose-aware placeholder rigging (armature rest matched to the mesh A-pose) before any character asset is adopted for gameplay. The tear remains a known defect and must not be mistaken for final art.

attachments.reason: The contract requires no attachments. The FBX contains exactly one mesh object (tripo_node_4bbbdf02-3c5d-4c3f-a696-8d3b13882154) plus the Armature; attachments and moving_parts are both empty. Cap, coat, belt, knife/pouch and boots are all part of the single skinned mesh.

style.reason: Design language and palette match the frozen front/side/back references: grey-green weathered storm coat with shoulder cape, peaked cap with gold badge, dark high-collar tunic, brown leather belt and boots, and a grim older captain face. Prototype-only mismatches: no revolver (pouch/knife only), the coat reads lighter and blockier, and the open chest reads as a black void with a floating strap instead of the reference's dark buttoned tunic. Acceptable for prototype_only status; noted for the art pass.

material_appearance.reason: One PBR material; base-colour and normal textures are 1024x1024 and embedded (reimport texture_count=2, both images 1024). The metallic-roughness map exists in textures/tex_military_officer_3d_model_rm.jpg.png but is not carried by the FBX exporter (texture_maps_dropped=1; only 2 images reimport), so Unity will need an explicit roughness/metallic fallback. At prototype stage this is acceptable and not a blocker. The black chest area in the preview is a texture/geometry artifact noted under style.
